name: oci_repository
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes OCI repository (Flux OCIRepository).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this OCI repository.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the OCI repository resource.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this OCI repository to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this OCI repository belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the OCI repository is created in.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Flux OCIRepository CRD apiVersion. Override if your cluster's Flux serves a different version (e.g. source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1).

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: URL of the OCI repository (e.g. oci://ghcr.io/org/charts).

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: Interval at which the OCI artifact is fetched (Go duration, e.g. 5m, 1h).

attributes.name: ref_tag
attributes.description: OCI artifact tag to pull (mutually exclusive with ref_semver/ref_digest).

attributes.name: ref_semver
attributes.description: Semver range used to select the artifact tag.

attributes.name: ref_semver_filter
attributes.description: Regex filter applied to tags before the semver range is evaluated.

attributes.name: ref_digest
attributes.description: Exact OCI artifact digest to pull (mutually exclusive with ref_tag/ref_semver).

attributes.name: oci_provider
attributes.description: Provider used for authentication (e.g. generic, aws, azure, gcp).

attributes.name: secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding registry credentials.

attributes.name: cert_secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding TLS certificate data.

attributes.name: proxy_secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding proxy configuration.

attributes.name: service_account_name
attributes.description: Service account used for workload-identity authentication to the registry.

attributes.name: layer_selector_media_type
attributes.description: Media type of the OCI layer to extract.

attributes.name: layer_selector_operation
attributes.description: How to handle the selected layer: extract or copy.

attributes.name: insecure
attributes.description: Allow connecting to an HTTP (non-TLS) OCI registry.

attributes.name: suspend
attributes.description: Suspend reconciliation of the repository.

attributes.name: ignore
attributes.description: Cluster-ignore (.gitignore-style) patterns of files to exclude from the artifact.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the OCI repository.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the OCI repository.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: oci_repository_id
attributes.description: ID of this OCI repository, for reference by dependent resources.
